text:
dara: Heads-up — Private/VPC release 2.7 includes two new privacy-focused features: (1) audit-log-export (S3/GCS) for customer-only audit trails, and (2) a local telemetry-proxy mode that lets customers collect telemetry to a customer-managed endpoint instead of Redwood. Launch schedule below.

vik: Nice. Does local telemetry-proxy still let us get anonymized health signals for platform-wide health?

maria: Short answer: only if the customer opts in to forward an anonymized stream to Redwood. By default in proxy mode, telemetry never leaves the customer-managed endpoint. We provide optional forwarders customers can enable.

compliance-bot: Compliance reminder: audit-log-export qualifies for our SOC2 evidence pack only when export is enabled and retention >= 90 days. See docs link in runbook.

dara: Important notes for ops and sales: this is targeted at regulated customers who require self-hosted telemetry or external audit archives. Its additional to the existing telemetry opt-in work — think of this as a customer-controlled sink + new per-tenant retention policy.

maria: For existing Private installs: 1) nothing flips automatically, 2) upgrade to 2.7 recommended, 3) runbook includes migration steps to enable export and proxy. We will send admins a one-click invite to try proxy in staging.

vik: CLI snippets please?

maria: Added below:

```
# enable audit log export to S3 for tenant
redwoodctl private update --tenant <TENANT_ID> \\  --set audit_export.s3.bucket=my-bucket --set audit_export.s3.region=us-west-2\\  --set audit_export.enabled=true

# enable local telemetry proxy mode (points telemetry to customer endpoint)
redwoodctl agent configure --agent-id <AGENT_ID> \\\\  --set telemetry.mode=proxy --set telemetry.proxy.endpoint=https://telemetry.internal.example.com/collect\\  --set telemetry.forwarding.enabled=false
```

dara: Support bundles and debug data: by default bundles remain available but are split: audit logs go to customer export, debug traces are redacted unless the customer enables full support-mode via the consent UI. We added a temporary-access API for customers to grant short-lived support access with strict audit trail.

deploy-bot: Release window scheduled: 2026-05-04 02:00 UTC. Change window: 40m. CI job: https://ci.internal/builds/78901. Staging smoke planned tonight 22:30 PT.

vik: Ops action: add monitors to watch export job failures and proxy backpressure. We should alert on >1% export error rate across tenants in first 24h.

ops_team: Noted. Well add an exporter health dashboard and SLOs for export latency.

maria: Docs/runbooks: docs/internal/onprem-audit-export-runbook.md, docs/internal/local-telemetry-proxy.md, docs/public/onprem-audit-export-kb.md (will publish with release notes).

dara: GTM: Ill post a short partner-friendly blurb in #product-commms: "Private 2.7: customer-controlled audit exports and telemetry proxy—designed for regulated workloads and data residency requirements." Please dont share external copy until legal signs off.

compliance-bot: Legal requested two changes to the customer-facing notice: a) explicit list of audit log fields exported, b) minimum retention options. Legal to supply redlines by EOD.

maria: Migration plan summary: 1) notify admins at release, 2) one-click enable in console + CLI, 3) webinar/demo for enterprise customers week after GA, 4) rollback plan documented in runbook. No silent opt-in.

dara: Thanks — quick sync tomorrow 08:30 PT for final rollout checklist. If you want to review runbooks now theyre in the docs/internal dir.

vik: :thumbsup:
